name: Skail / Strath Naver
date_basis: Reported start day; exact time and arrival within each cell unknown
evidence: Copernicus reports a wildfire in north Sutherland starting 15 April. NatureScot Skail polygons have the same date and location; both fragments share one event ID.

name: West Halladale
date_basis: Independently reported event day; exact ignition and cell arrival unknown
evidence: JNCC Report 730, printed page 27, describes a large wildfire affecting Halladale on 12 May 2019 and extending into Forsinard Flows. Matches the named NatureScot extent.

name: Glenuig / Kinloch Moidart
date_basis: Reported response interval; ignition day and cell arrival unresolved
evidence: Local reporting with resident testimony describes the wildfire response on 19-21 April. The FBU independently describes the three-day Glenuig wildfire. NatureScot records the extent on 21 April; that date is not treated as ignition.
